hook: Viewers should know what they will learn within the first two seconds.
caption:
Viewers should know what they will learn within the first two seconds.

Add captions to every video, because most people watch with the sound off.

Check each caption against the audio before you publish, because a wrong word destroys trust quickly.

Try this on your next episode and compare.
